name: Moj lichnyj "Raj"
source:
Sovyonok is a true Paradise on Earth, but how does the perception of this heaven change over time? And how will a person, trapped in their own personal Paradise, change?

[spoiler]Backstory of the [url=/c161072]Pioner[/url].[/spoiler]
translation:
索维诺克是真正的人间天堂，但随着时间的推移，人们对这个天堂的看法会发生怎样的变化呢？一个人被困在自己的个人天堂里，会发生怎样的改变？

[spoiler][url=/c161072]Pioner[/url].[/spoiler]的背景故事
